title: Checkpoint: word stats pipeline
prompt: Implement `analyze(words)` returning a `WordStats` record with three parts, each built with streams: `byInitial` maps each lowercase first letter to how many words start with it (case-insensitive); `longest` lists every word whose length equals the maximum length found (original casing, in original order); `joined` is `Optional` of all words joined by `" & "`, empty when the input is empty.

tests.name: initials are counted case-insensitively
all ties share the crown
tests.hint: Two passes are fine: find the max length first, then filter equals.

tests.name: joined is Optional, empty-safe
tests.hint: Collectors.joining(" & ") over an empty stream yields "" - wrap with Optional.ofNullable after filtering that case, or guard it.
